title: First Operations
description: Your first field assignment. A contact in Kraków has gone dark after intercepting a courier route. Find out what happened.

operations.title: The Silent Contact
operations.openingText: The safe house door was unlocked. Your contact left in a hurry — but they left the grid behind for you.
operations.cliffhangerText: The trail ends at the river. Whatever your contact found, someone else wanted it more.
operations.returnMessageText: The safe house is cold. The operation window is closing.

tiles.contentBody: The door hangs open. Inside, everything is packed except a city map with a grid drawn over it.
You search the rooms top to bottom. Someone wiped the surfaces — professionally.
Behind the heavy bookcase you find fresh scratches on the wall. Something was hidden here.
A torn note: 'Courier crosses Planty at dusk, grey cap, left pocket.' Your contact was watching someone.
A tram ticket stamped 18:42. The route passes Wawel Hill. The meeting was not random — it was scheduled.

threatOptions.successOutcome: The watcher never saw you coming. His radio is yours now.
threatOptions.failureOutcome: He fights back harder than expected before going down.

threatOptions.successOutcome: You lose him in the market crowd before he can call it in.
He pockets the money and forgets your face.
After twenty minutes he checks his phone and walks away.

tiles.contentBody: A waterproof pouch taped under the sink: field money and a clean phone.
Under the third bench on the river path: your contact's notebook. Half the pages are torn out — but the map survived.

puzzles.flavorText: You piece together the surveillance timeline.

content.question: The tram ticket was stamped at 18:42. What does that tell you about the meeting?
content.explanation: A stamped ticket used at a specific hour means the route was planned.

operations.title: The Drop
operations.openingText: The notebook map leads uphill. Tonight the courier makes the exchange — and you intend to be watching.
operations.cliffhangerText: The courier never showed. Either the drop was moved — or someone knew you were coming.
operations.returnMessageText: The overlook is empty. The window has passed.

tiles.contentBody: Tourists everywhere. Perfect cover. You take position by the wall and start counting faces.
From the tower you can see both gates. Two watchers, one on each — this drop is protected.
The service gate lock is cheap. Ten seconds of pressure and it gives.

tiles.narrativeAnchorSummary: Player intercepts a coded radio message between the two watchers; hint at the real drop location

tiles.contentBody: The notebook's last page is a grid reference encoded as a checksum. Solve it to find the real drop site.

threatOptions.successOutcome: Fast and quiet. The patrol is down before the radio clicks.
threatOptions.failureOutcome: The fight draws attention. You finish it, but the castle is alert.

threatOptions.successOutcome: Down the castle steps, through the tourist crowd. Gone.
A folded note changes hands. The patrol remembers nothing.
You hold position in the shadows until the patrol's route takes them past.

tiles.contentBody: The groundskeeper left his spare key under a pot — and a thermos that buys you a warm hour of surveillance.
Grey cap, left pocket — the notebook was right. You photograph the handover from the colonnade. Mission accomplished: you know who they are now.

puzzles.flavorText: The checksum is a simple arithmetic grid key.

content.question: The reference key is 7 × 8 − 19. Decode the grid cell.
